notes.subject: עורה / אעירה
notes.rationale: Kokura-kɔrɔ: 'yɛlɛma' ladamulen kɛra minɛ-ko-kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen (bɔɔlu dɔw) ni fɛn min yɛlɛmara (sɔgɔma) cɛ — a maga Bamanankan na.

notes.subject: אעירה שחר
notes.rationale: 'Ne bɛ sɔgɔma yɛlɛma' (sɔgɔma la fɔnɔ) walima 'ne bɛ sɔgɔma feere' (nɔgɔya donkili) — YLT ni JPS ye fɔlɔ min fɔ.

notes.subject: sɛbɛnni
notes.rationale: Wele-yɔrɔ dɔ: 'Yɛlɛn-w!' kɔrɔbɔli-w la, donkili-minɛcogo ye.

translation: Yɛlɛn-w, nebel ni kinor; ne bɛna sɔgɔma yɛlɛma.
